summary: [continue] The "sshd: WARN: host key not found" message is a standard, benign warning that appears when SSH host keys haven't been generated yet — typical on first boot of a fresh firmware image. The device successfully reached the login prompt (U-Boot → kernel → login), confirming the boot process completed normally. At t=0s with the run just starting, this is not indicative of any failure; the device is operating as expected.
